verdict.rationale: Fellow's REST API covers meaningful read and write surfaces: listing and reading notes, recordings and transcripts, writing, appending, prepending and find-replacing agenda content in round-trippable Fellow Markdown, completing or archiving action items, uploading recordings, and admin delete/export. However, nothing claims UI parity, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent. Note deletion is restricted to super admins, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: API coverage of recording/retention policy settings, bot and recording configuration, keyword tracking, transcript redaction, Ask Fellow, and workspace or user administration; an explicit parity claim; independent hands-on corroboration.
